correctness.rationale: All sixteen edge pairings reduce by explicit polygon-line algebra to five affine two-step cases. These preserve L=m+n+epsilon; the depth state has least cycle 2L+1, which antipodally swaps both edge indices and centrally reflects both depth coordinates. Two such cycles and no fewer return the original point, hence least Phi-period 8L+4. Determinant Jacobians give the exact invariant density; parity weights 2/3 and 1/3, independent dyadic-geometric depths, and exact convolution prove the probability law, tail and moment threshold. The universal proof is explicit in RESULT.md. As supporting checks, 400 full-cell symbolic affine transitions were tested by exact polygon clipping, and the packaged self-contained exact-rational checker passed 800 dynamical assertions, 16 weights and 25 distribution tail identities.

value.rationale: A canonical fully periodic polygon pair with arbitrarily large periods was previously known only qualitatively. An exact pointwise least-period function, all attained periods, and an invariant-area probability distribution (including a nontrivial geometric-polynomial tail, finite mean, sharp exponential-moment threshold) are natural quantitative questions about that same example. Their complete determination and link to a dyadic state machine provide mathematical structure beyond routine numerical enumeration or a corollary of full periodicity.
